result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and a refuge island at this signalized intersection increases exposure risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island to provide a safe waiting area.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without clear guidance on when to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a signalized crossing on the side street. However, the wide turning radii and lack of markings across the main road leg increase pedestrian exposure to traffic. Dense vegetation at the corner further complicates safety by potentially obstructing sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for higher-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians at the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of Wayne Av and the main road

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Dense trees and bushes near the corner may hide pedestrians from approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the signal pole

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalk across the main road leg despite the presence of a traffic signal.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to tighten the turning radius and reduce pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style crosswalk markings to all legs of the intersection to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove vegetation near the intersection to improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized intersection on a multi-lane arterial road with marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and sidewalks are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single phase without a physical refuge island.

hazards.name: High-Speed Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and multiple through lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing risk in the event of a collision.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing and reduce total exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing / Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce travel lane widths or repurpose a lane for a protected bike lane to naturally slow traffic and shorten the crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and a sidewalk on the left side. A significant portion of the right side of the intersection is obscured by a large blur, preventing a full assessment of traffic controls or infrastructure in that area.

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The wide corner on the left allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds across the pedestrian crossing path.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: No visible stop signs or signals are present to regulate vehicle traffic at the marked crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and tighten the turn radius to slow down vehicles.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver awareness and yielding rates at the crosswalk.
